name: IDD: Indian Driving Dataset for Autonomous Navigation in Unconstrained Environments
description: IDD is a specialized dataset for autonomous driving perception in unstructured and unconstrained traffic environments, collected by IIIT Hyderabad. It consists of 10,004 road scene images captured across Bangalore and Hyderabad with dense pixel-level annotations across a 4-level label hierarchy of 34 classes. It uniquely captures ambiguous road boundaries, mixed unstructured traffic, and non-standard vehicle interactions.
